observations: The readable front label identifies Compass Box Hedonism², a 49% ABV blended grain Scotch whisky with an outturn of 648 bottles.

dbOutcome.summary: Production search on 2026-08-02 returned eight other Hedonism bottles but no Hedonism² row. Photo identification proposed creation but routed the user to the manual Bottle form, so the observed flow created no Bottle automatically.

catalogFieldObservations.notes: The Muse is a different named Hedonism release and cannot cover the photographed Hedonism² exclusive.

provenance.notes: The checked-in photo is the observed add-bottle source. The current Hedonism Wines exclusive collection identifies this bottle as Compass Box Hedonism², a blended grain made from North British, Port Dundas, and Girvan whiskies whose youngest components are 23 years old, bottled at 49% ABV. Whiskybase independently records a 23-year stated age, Compass Box as bottler, and 2023 as the bottling year. The photographed label and Whiskybase record an outturn of 648 bottles; the retailer copy inconsistently says 600 while also displaying '1 of 648', so outturn remains an observation and is not a required Bottle field. Production already has Compass Box (entity 1422), North British (1204), Port Dundas (1270), and Girvan (944), so classification must reuse those entities. Production search returned eight other Hedonism results, including three malformed rows under a separate Hedonism Brand; none is Hedonism². This readable, externally corroborated image proposal should have no unresolved identity risk and should be eligible for confirm-create rather than manual form review.

expected.summary: Create one complete Compass Box Hedonism² Bottle with its 23-year age, Compass Box bottler, North British/Port Dundas/Girvan distillers, 2023 release year, and 49% ABV.
